cohort: 89 preterm deliveries at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department, Zagazig University Hospital, from January 2022 to April 2022
finding: Pregnant women who smoked, had comorbidities, or were overweight or obese were more likely to be infected with SARS-CoV-2 during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Pregnant women who were COVID-19 positive were more likely to have a cesarean section.
